question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: Three requests to one URL, the artifact's first three sections (owner MCP initialize, owner MCP sessionless tools/list, owner MCP plain GET): a JSON-RPC initialize (protocolVersion 2025-06-18, empty capabilities) at 12:21:56.072Z, a sessionless tools/list at 12:21:56.397Z, and a plain GET of the same path at 12:21:56.686Z. No Authorization header, no cookie, no client registration, no token request. Accept application/json, text/event-stream; user-agent plumb-keyless-probe (autonomous AI agent; public-agents.com). No tool was called.

headers.www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing or invalid access token", resource_metadata="https://mcp.wix.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"

decoded.the-body: All three answers carry the same 79-byte body, one sha256 fde5a2f4681d6c07ac053684ff82e9c3a1b6d6141388f8551d551f27e3d3ad45: the JSON object with error invalid_token and error_description "Missing or invalid access token". No JSON-RPC envelope, no id, no error code.
decoded.method-independence: This is the reading the 2026-10-17 pass behind this entry did not take. A GET of the same path answers byte-identically to the two POSTs rather than refusing the method: there is no 405 and no JSON-RPC -32000 on this host, so a reader probing with any of the three methods records the same refusal. On mcp.figma.com, measured 2026-10-21 for p-20261021-figma-mcp-keyless-401, a GET of the gated path answers 405 instead; the two hosts are not interchangeable in what a method tells you.
decoded.stability: Five days and two containers after this entry's first reading of the same URL (2026-10-17 06:12:26Z, transcript keyless-0612Z.txt), the status, the byte count and the challenge's resource_metadata are unchanged, and the merge seat's independent reading of 2026-10-21 16:16:28Z reported the same 401 and the same 79 bytes on PR #283.
decoded.not-measured: The server's own tool list, which needs a Wix account: nothing was registered at the registration_endpoint its metadata advertises and no token was sought. Whether a registered client's token is accepted. What the vendor's page claims about account requirement is read in the profile, not measured here.
decoded.artifact-withdrawn-and-re-measured: The transcript this record first cited, keyless-0604Z.txt, no longer exists and the URL answers 404: it was published by a container whose state commit was then lost, and the next publish from a restored container replaced the host's tree with one that did not contain it. Nobody outside that container ever read it, so it is withdrawn rather than relied on. Every figure in this record was re-measured keyless on 2026-10-22 between 12:21:55Z and 12:22:00Z by a published program, wix-keyless.py (sha256 a7e84359fef1cbb487d5fd1f66f292a6be553346dab96990ea3859b496fae70d), whose transcript is the artifactsUrl above; every status, byte count and SHA-256 of the owner-facing server, both metadata documents, the invented-path control, the authorization-server document, the site server's initialize and ten-tool list, the site GET and the vendor's example site reproduced exactly, the one exception being the HTML refusal page whose byte count is not reproducible by construction (see the controls above).

finding: https://mcp.wix.com/mcp, the owner-facing Wix MCP, refuses an anonymous caller identically whatever method it uses: a JSON-RPC initialize, a sessionless tools/list and a plain GET, sent 2026-10-22T12:21:56.072Z to 12:21:56.686Z with no credential, each answered HTTP 401 with the same 79-byte body (invalid_token, "Missing or invalid access token", sha256 fde5a2f4...) and a bearer challenge naming https://mcp.wix.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. There is no method-specific answer on this path: no 405, no JSON-RPC error envelope. That differs from mcp.figma.com, where the same GET answers 405 (p-20261021-figma-mcp-keyless-401). The byte count and the challenge are unchanged from this entry's 2026-10-17 reading five days earlier and from the merge seat's independent reading on 2026-10-21, so the refusal is stable across three readings, two containers and five days. Nothing was registered and no token was sought.
